canonical_name: Romancing the Muse: Sunday Edition (Story Parlor Sunday Sessions)
summary: A monthly drop-in creative-writing workshop at Story Parlor, facilitated by writer/performer R Lyon Bergh as part of the venue's 'Sunday Sessions' programming. It blends timed writing prompts, light movement/meditation, and optional group sharing, but is explicitly free and open to the public rather than a membership-based community.

evidence.note: Description says the session was 'born from the Writing Without an Outline series' and is facilitated by R Lyon Bergh; no membership, dues, or sign-up language appears in any of the 5 listings.

WebFetch of the listing confirms it is part of Story Parlor's 'Sunday Sessions' program, is FREE to the public ('Come as you are'), with only a suggested $10 donation paid directly to the facilitator, and links only to the venue's general Sunday Sessions page, not to any group page.

R Lyon Bergh is a working writer/performer/facilitator who runs multiple paid workshops at Story Parlor (e.g. 'Writing without an Outline', 'Taming the Muse' weekend intensives), consistent with a business booking a recurring facilitator rather than a self-organized club.

Search for the event name plus Asheville surfaces only Story Parlor's own calendar pages and Bergh's personal site (rlyonbergh.com); no dedicated Facebook group, Meetup, or community page exists for 'Romancing the Muse' itself.
